records.name: James Matthew Kukucka
records.note: Mason's 2025 commencement program lists Wing Lam as Kukucka's advisor for the matching dissertation. Bell's CV lists Kukucka as a PhD advisee with the same dissertation title and documents co-advising with Paul Ammann after Bell left GMU, during 2019–2025. These sources establish advising relationships with all three people, but do not establish the exact succession or Wing's start date. The owner's suggested Bell-to-Ammann-to-Lam succession is a hypothesis, not direct confirmation. Restored Wing Lam after an overly strong web-based replacement with Bell; retained the earlier research-advising evidence here because the roster has no historical-advisors field. Co-Advisor remains blank rather than arbitrarily choosing one of the two documented research advisers. This research does not confer Verified: Yes.
